title: Notification history in online games
description: The bell with its unread badge and the list of recent notifications now work in multiplayer games (seat and spectator), not only offline. The 'Recent notifications' pill under the corner toasts is gone wherever the bell shows. On a portrait phone the bell is a 44 px button in the bottom dock (Players / Objectives / bell / Events / Feedback); on desktop it sits in the header row next to Objectives. The list opens above the Players, Objectives and Events sheets. Mocked game on a mocked public server; toasts pushed after load.
